info.description: Gather basic information. Set to false to disable.

disk.description: Run disk tests. Set to false to disable.

job_file.description: Path to the fio job file to use.

overwrite.description: Actually destroy the given device. Destructive.

write_size.description: Size to write to disk, bytes or percentage.

directory.description: Directory to perform file tests in. Leave empty to use default.

cpu.description: Run CPU tests. Set to false to disable.

network.description: Run network tests. Set to false to disable.

iperf_time.description: Timeout for iperf test, in seconds.

email.description: Email address to send reports to.

logfile.description: Path to write reports. Default is stressant-$HOSTNAME.log.
